ledgerline_both_targets.description: A B2B marketing ops posting, filed under B2C lifecycle (the design's AppFit board). The B2B target fits; the B2C one does not. The posting's note to AI tools must change nothing.

ledgerline_only_b2c.description: The same posting when the person has only the B2C target. Nothing fits well, so best_target_id is null and a note says what differs. The app then offers to make a target from the posting.

mismatch_notes: This posting is B2B; your closest target is B2C lifecycle.
The role is marketing ops, not lifecycle.

per_target.why: Different buyer and a different role: the posting is B2B marketing ops.

kestrel_both_targets.description: A consumer payments startup hiring a senior lifecycle manager (the posting behind ../questions and ../resume). The B2C target fits; the B2B one does not.

never: target_fit is judged from the posting text only: no facts about Ledgerline or Kestrel Pay that the posting does not state, and no target id inside a why or a mismatch note.
